sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C13037 and card C13037-K1. On 2016-12-15 at 04:04:09, an online transaction of $149.92 was conducted using the device profile Windows | Windows 7 | chrome 60.0 | 2112x1188. The bank's real-time risk score flagged the activity at 0.84, and the transaction model scored it at a maximum 1.000. Graph evidence shows this rare, fully specified device profile appears on only three cards in the entire dataset. On 2016-12-13, the same device was used on two other cards (C05116-K1 and C06532-K2) belonging to different customers, which the transaction model also scored as fraud. This cross-account activity from a single rare device indicates a coordinated effort to exploit compromised card numbers. The total exposure for this card is $149.92, contributing to a broader $449.89 network exposure, prompting the bank to block the card and monitor connected accounts.
